images.title: Take away 4 tokens
images.purpose: Show that taking 4 green tokens away from 5 green tokens leaves 1 green token, so (+5) − (+4) = +1.
images.composition: One tray with tokens on the left, a clear gap, and a separate taken-away group on the right, one equation below.
images.exact_structure: Left: one rounded grey #6B7280 tray holding 5 equal round green tokens (teal #0072B2) in a line; the last 4 tokens are drawn faded, and the first 1 token is solid and ringed in amber #E69F00. Right, outside the tray: the 4 faded tokens again as a group of 4 with a reddish purple #CC79A7 arrow pointing from the tray to them. Exactly 5 tokens in the tray, 4 taken away, 1 left.
